name: GOV.UK Webform Elements
description: Provides GOV.UK Design System form components (e.g. date input) for Webform.
project_description:
Webform GOV.UK Elements builds upon the Webform module to provide GOV.UK Design System Webform elements.

 Back to top 

 Purpose 
 GOV.UK Webform Elements provides reusable GOV.UK Design System compliment composite elements for use on webforms. These composites can be customized via a provided ui and be used like standard composites across multiple webforms.

 Currently this project consists of a GOV.UK Design System composite date element (more coming).

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 The Webform module https://www.drupal.org/project/webform
